summary: All 4 iter-121 Finance fixes verified end-to-end (8/8 backend pytest passed + frontend Playwright). FIX-1 legacy Kas Kecil 1-1101 profile mappings force-set in Mongo for ar_payment/ap_payment/expense/employee_loan_disbursement/asset_disposal are correctly re-migrated to Bank 1-1201 by upgrade_posting_profiles(). FIX-2 POST /api/rahaza/cash-accounts with opening_balance 2.500.000 → gl_account_code populated, _opening_post.ok true with je_number, JE source_module cash_opening_balance balanced Dr bank/Cr 3-1000 = 2.500.000; GET returns balance from GL, balance_source 'gl', balance_diff 0. After AR payments (200k with account + 100k no-account) balance = 2.700.000 == balance_mutasi (diff 0); /finance-summary cash_balance = Σ active accounts (cash_balance_source 'gl'); POST /cash-accounts/sync-gl idempotent (opening JE count stays 1). AR /payments enriched: account_code/account_name (Tanpa rekening → '—') + gl_je_number per baris; no-account JE debits 1-1201 (not 1-1101). AP invoice + 2 payments same pattern verified. FIX-3 marketplace return → CN gl_mode='settlement', gl_je_id null, no credit_note JE, no MARKETPLACE customer; retry POST /post-to-gl → 409. FIX-4 wh return kondisi Baik restock 3 pcs → cogs_je_number populated JE cogs_marketplace_return Dr 1-1404 = Cr 5-1000 = 3×hpp balanced, hpp_unit_cost>0, hpp_layer_id set, fg_cost_layers new doc qty_in=3 breakdown.source='marketplace_return'. Kondisi Rusak → no hpp_layer_id / no cogs_je_number. Frontend: rahaza-cash-page renders 4 ca-card-*, all ca-source-* = 'Saldo Buku Besar', no ca-gl-warning, ca-sync-gl clickable. AR payment history modal (ar-history-*) shows payment-row-* + payment-je-* JE numbers + payment-history-total 'Rp 1.000.000'. AP detail (ap-view-<id> → InvoiceDetail) renders ap-payment-history section with 2 payment rows + JE numbers + total Rp 150.000.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rahaza_posting_profiles.py PROFILE_CODE_FIXES applies unconditionally on every upgrade — good idempotent behaviour but any operator-intended override of these 5 keys will be silently reverted on next startup; consider a `preserve_manual` flag or a log line whenever an override is rewritten.

routes/rahaza_finance.py _decorate_cash_balances always sets balance_diff = gl - mutasi; when gl_account_code is None it forces balance_diff = 0 while balance_source = 'field' — the UI warning ca-gl-warning depends solely on diff, so a rekening tanpa GL will NOT flash a warning even though request expects it 'bila ada … rekening tanpa GL'. Verify UI checks balance_source in addition to diff.

routes/marketing_returns_routes.py create_credit_note still calls post_credit_note() on a settlement CN; post_credit_note now short-circuits when gl_mode=='settlement' but the extra round-trip is wasted work — an early skip inside create_credit_note would be cleaner and prevent accidental double-JE risk if the guard is ever removed.

routes/dewi_wh_returns.py resolve_return: HPP fallback path (rahaza_materials.hpp/unit_cost) works but does not create fg_cost_layers row — the request spec says 'jika 0 → cogs_post_error "HPP retur 0"'; add explicit test coverage for that edge case (not exercised here because seeded FG hpp is >0).
seed_data_creation: 3 cash accounts BCA-IT121-<epoch> (opening balance 2.500.000 each with opening JE cash_opening_balance), 1 customer CUSTIT121<epoch>, 4 AR invoices AR-20260906-001..004 (1 paid, 3 partial_paid Rp 200.000 outstanding), 1 AP invoice AP-20260906-001 (Vendor IT121, total 300k, 150k paid), 2 wh_returns (WH-RET-000xx: 1 Resolved Baik with JE cogs_marketplace_return + fg_cost_layer, 1 Karantina Rusak), 1 credit_note CN-<date>-xxx gl_mode 'settlement' (no JE). All prefixed for easy cleanup.
